name: Redshade turns Reap into Thresh and then Bloodshatter
contract: Redshade 524735 promises that using Reap transforms it into Thresh for 10 seconds, and its buff Thresh (Dummy) 525058 says so on the character. Casting Thresh then leaves Bloodshatter (Dummy) 525299 for the second step. Both are plain SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, so spell_ascension_reaper_redshade_reap is what sends the replacement from every rank of Reap, and aura_ascension_reaper_redshade_transform redraws the button with SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL. Neither half touches the spellbook: teaching the transforms made the client announce every learn and unlearn in chat, and the learn hooks re-ran the spec synchronisation, which announced every rank of Reap along with them. Both transforms also read Generates 1 Soul Fragment and generating Runic Power, and neither record performs either, so ResourceGainRules pays them the way it pays every rank of Reap.
